big_case.notes: A statewide proof-of-citizenship voting initiative with ~710k signatures, seeking emergency placement on Michigan's November 2026 ballot, is politically salient. But the posture was a first-instance mandatory injunction on a constructive-denial theory of section 1257 jurisdiction while the Michigan Supreme Court mandamus case was still pending, and the Court itself treated it as routine: a single-Justice denial, no referral, no writing. Moderate stakes for Michigan's ballot, no doctrinal footprint. This candidate recorded no big_case_score, so there was nothing to anchor on.
